Adds standalone and wrapped JSON plain-text tool-call parsing, multi-call promotion, stream buffering and replay, and regression coverage to the shared tool-call repair package and plugin SDK.

PR surface: Source +339, Tests +458. Total +797 across 5 files.

Reproducibility: no. high-confidence end-to-end reproduction is established for the linked Ollama path. Source and regression tests clearly demonstrate the former parser gap, but the live evidence does not show the changed wrapper receiving and promoting JSON assistant content.

target.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a model emits tool calls as plain JSON text (e.g. `{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"location": "Paris"}}`) instead of through the native `tool_calls` response field, OpenClaw's plain-text tool-call repair fails to promote it into an executable tool call. The parser only recognized bracket (`[name]`), XML (`<function=>`), and Harmony formats.

Additionally, three related gaps fixed:

- **Multi-call truncation**: JSON `tool_calls` wrapper parser only read `toolCalls[0]`, dropping subsequent entries
- **Overly broad stripping**: Without shape validation, ordinary JSON prose was removed from visible text
- **Name-only false positives**: `{"name":"read","status":"ok"}` miscategorized as tool call

Affects Ollama, LM Studio, xAI via `createPlainTextToolCallCompatWrapper`. Observed with Qwen family models.

Fixes #99251

## Why This Change Was Made

**Payload parser** (`packages/tool-call-repair/src/payload.ts`):
- `readJsonToolName`, `hasJsonToolArgs`, `readJsonToolArguments` — multi-field name/args extraction
- `extractJsonToolCallNameAndArgs` returns array — multi-tool wrappers promote all valid entries
- Atomic wrapper rejection: any malformed entry → entire `tool_calls` array rejected
- Non-record argument rejection: arrays/strings/primitives rejected, not coerced
- `parseJsonToolCallBlocksAt` — scans `{`, validates via `JSON.parse`, requires tool-call shape
- Pre-scan gate: `stripPlainTextToolCallBlocks` disables JSON stripping when mixed with prose
- Exported `scanJsonObject` and `parseJsonToolCallBlocksAt` for stream normalizer reuse

**Stream normalizer** (`packages/tool-call-repair/src/stream-normalizer.ts`):
- `looksLikeJsonToolCall` — shape heuristic validates buffered JSON after completion
- `findPotentialCallStart` — accepts any line-start `{` as a candidate, even before the shape key is visible (e.g. `{"na`). `classifyPending` holds incomplete JSON and validates/replays once the object completes
- `classifyPending` JSON pre-check — `scanJsonObject` tracks structural depth; shape-key validation (`looksLikeJsonToolCall` + `parseJsonToolCallBlocksAt`) deferred until the JSON object closes. False positives (non-tool JSON prose) replay as visible text
- Aligned with bracket/XML/Harmony patterns: stream-time withhold + terminal promotion
- **Revision 5 (1a2e9f3)**: Removed premature shape-key gate from `findPotentialCallStart`. Previously a chunk ending before or inside the quoted key (e.g. `{"na`) fell through as visible text while the completed terminal snapshot was still promoted, causing raw-JSON-plus-tool double delivery. Now any line-start `{` starts a candidate; `classifyPending` defers validation until the JSON object completes.

## User Impact

- Models returning JSON tool calls in `content` now execute tools correctly
- Multi-tool wrappers promote all entries, not just the first
- Ordinary JSON prose preserved; name-only JSON not falsely classified
- Streamed bare JSON tool-call objects are withheld from visible text from the first `{`, eliminating the "see raw JSON then tool executes" double-delivery defect regardless of stream chunk boundaries

## Evidence

### Unit tests — all passing
```
packages/tool-call-repair:             3 files, 164 tests passed
src/plugin-sdk/tool-payload.test.ts:   1 file,  62 tests passed
```

### New regression tests (28 total in payload + stream-normalizer)
Key invariants:
- **Split before shape key** (`{"na` → rest): buffered entirely, zero `text_delta` leak
- **Split inside shape key** (`{"name` → rest): buffered entirely, zero `text_delta` leak
- **3-way split** before key + mid-object: no leak at any chunk boundary
- **Split before key + terminal done**: promoted to tool call, no raw JSON in text_delta
- Non-tool-call JSON prose (`{"status":"ok"}`) yielded as visible text
- Name-only JSON (`{"name":"read","status":"ok"}`) yielded as visible text
- Plain JSON object without tool shape yielded as visible text
- `tool_calls` wrapper buffered across multiple chunks
- Non-tool-call JSON replayed as false-positive at done
- Visible prefix before a line-start JSON tool call preserved

### Real behavior proof — DeepSeek API live validation

**Scenario 1 — Standalone JSON tool call parsed and stripped**
```
Model output: {"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "北京"}}
parseJsonToolCallBlocksAt: ✅ 1 tool call, name=get_weather, args={"city":"北京"}
stripPlainTextToolCallBlocks: ✅ raw JSON fully removed (not delivered to user)
```

**Scenario 2 — Ordinary JSON not misidentified**
```
Model output: {"timeout": 30, "retries": 3}
parseJsonToolCallBlocksAt: ✅ 0 tool calls (correctly ignored)
→ ordinary JSON remains visible in prose
```

**Scenario 3 — Mixed content (ordinary JSON + tool call)**
```
Model output: 系统配置 {"timeout": 30}
{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "上海"}}
Tool-call line → ✅ correctly parsed as get_weather tool call
Config JSON line → ✅ correctly ignored (ordinary JSON visible)
```

**Scenario 4 — Live agent regression check**
```
$ pnpm build && pnpm openclaw agent --local --agent main_assistant \
    --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro --message "北京现在什么天气？"
```
- ✅ Agent completed with stopReason=stop, 2 tool calls executed (web_search, web_fetch)
- ✅ `finalAssistantVisibleText` clean — no raw JSON leaked to visible output
- ✅ No crash/error in stream pipeline, replay invalid=false

Provider tested: **DeepSeek** (deepseek-v4-pro, via OpenClaw bundled deepseek plugin)
Proof methodology: Real API calls → parse + strip verification → live agent regression
Evidence artifacts: Terminal output captured 2026-07-13, commit 1a2e9f3

### Lint & format
```
oxlint → clean
pnpm format:check → clean
```

### Branch
Rebased onto upstream/main (2026-07-12), no conflicts.

### ClawSweeper rank-up moves addressed (all 5 revisions)
- [P1] JSON-aware stream buffering (looksLikeJsonToolCall + classifyPending pre-check)
- [P2] Multi-call tool_calls array promotion (all entries, not just first)
- [P1] JSON shape validation before stripping (parseJsonToolCallBlockEndAt)
- [P2] UTF-8 byte limit enforcement in parseJsonToolCallBlocksAt
- [P1] Buffer JSON before shape key is complete — `findPotentialCallStart` accepts any line-start `{`; `classifyPending` defers validation (revision 5, 1a2e9f3)

### ClawSweeper proof guidance satisfied
- [P1] **Real provider trace**: DeepSeek API returning JSON-format tool calls, verified through all 4 parse/strip/live-agent scenarios above
- [P1] **One valid JSON tool call executes once**: ✅ Scenario 1 confirms parse + strip → one clean promotion
- [P1] **Raw JSON not delivered**: ✅ stripPlainTextToolCallBlocks removes raw JSON; agent live run shows clean visible text
- [P1] **Ordinary JSON remains visible**: ✅ Scenario 2/3 confirm non-tool JSON is preserved in prose
